'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Marvin Tegeler DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Marvin Tegeler]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open CCT Tegeler DS 2015 EC.txt |Download]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
